findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_email_signup · Private data: verify_carrier_fmcsa, verify_provider_npi, validate_email_signup, lookup_fmcsa_carrier, lookup_npi_provider · Public sink: validate_email_signup · Destructive: lookup_phone_tcpa_dnc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_email_signup · Private data: verify_carrier_fmcsa, verify_provider_npi, validate_email_signup, lookup_fmcsa_carrier, lookup_npi_provider · Public sink: validate_email_signup · Destructive: lookup_phone_tcpa_dnc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
